contextual_proposal.status: Separate contextual proposal. Only 3 to Z is supported by a surviving p157 coordinate. The additional F to D and S to E require two further p151 observed-coordinate changes whose counterpart positions lie in p157's absent prefix.

prior_credit: Published Nov7–9 key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), George Lasry (2017 key list).
The earlier p151 A1 conditional edition and p157 A2–A5 source edition by icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro remain unchanged. Their previous repository candidates and provenance are frozen separately.
This supplement supplies a reproducible relation between incomplete physical copies and a separately priced contextual ending; it makes no first-historical-decipherment claim.
limits: The p157 source alone fixes no complete plaintext position under this particular 190-slot geometry; copied coordinates must not be represented as independently recovered p157 source.

All 25 short-group alignment combinations are retained. Four attain the same minimum observed disagreement with the p151 witness; the displayed primary is one representative, not a unique loss location.
The five printed dashes remain occupied source slots and are filled separately from the 107 hypothetical absent coordinates. No observed coordinate is deleted or moved.
p151 A2 has a different 186-slot body from p157 A2's 200 slots. This source relation does not equate their complete five-part telegrams.
The primary shared reading retains STURZFSS. STURZ DES is a further contextual proposal, not a coordinate-agreement result or a verified historical event.
